note: Read 2026-11-04 by the research of a series and a play in every market (scratchpad l4t: the first wave t1-t8 and the follow-up u1-u25, merged item by item, the later verdict standing where it read more): what a series' and a play's producer can draw on there. Each quote kept was found in its saved file (the integrator's check, 2026-11-04); a quote not found there was left out, and a figure with none left was left out with it. Attempts recorded for a web search the shared allowance refused were dropped, not being attempts.

sources.title: Kanuni za Filamu na Michezo ya Kuigiza, 2020 (GN No. 488 of 2020, under the Films and Stage Plays Act, Cap. 230), the Tanzania Film Board's copy of the Gazette supplement

figures.finding: Tanzania: producer-TZ.json holds the Film Board's permit fees and practitioner licensing (no rebate published). Not reached today for series funding or stage. No incentive: the Regulations (read whole) impose a production permit per episode on a series and a per-minute classification fee; they grant no rebate or relief. The producer-TZ.json permit figures (TZS 50,000 a film for a first to fifth film) are the same schedule's item 1(i). Whether the Finance Acts give any relief was not read. The Regulations, read whole (70 pages), apply to mainland Tanzania only (reg. 2); Zanzibar is not covered by them and was not researched.

seriesPermit.covers: each episode of a tamthiliya (TV drama serial) and each short film under 40 minutes
